title: Gesture
description: A gesture about to be made, by a person or an agent acting for one, as the policy engine reads it before the command runs (doctrine D-058, spec 112): who, what, on what, how much, through which channel, towards whom. The same gesture by a person and by her agent is the same gesture.

actor.description: Who makes it. An agent always acts for a person.

on_behalf_of.description: The person an agent acts for.

kind.description: What it does, named by the product: invoice.validate, message.client, purchase.commit, contract.sign, document.read…

object.description: What it acts on: a project, a party, a document, a card.

amount.description: How much it commits, in the currency's smallest unit.

channel.description: Through which channel it goes out, when it reaches someone: whatsapp, telegram, mail, web.

party.description: The party outside it reaches, when it does.

template.description: The approved template it uses, when it writes to someone outside.

context.description: What else the product's policies read (an hour, a retention, an absence), flat.

at.description: When it is about to be made.
